summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial statements, MD&A, CEO and CFO certifications, and a news release. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, not a special situation.
